incumbent_comparison: Clearly better than hammock_with_stand-v003: the actual production output now shows the sagging seven-stripe sling from room scale and two interior close views. The v003 mesh data existed but had been hidden by back-face culling.

observations.art_direction_fit: Neutral striped fabric and charcoal metal preserve the room's restrained palette and low-poly presentation.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail capture resolves the woven color bands and sag, while the three-quarter and interior-oblique captures keep both support ends visible.
observations.gameplay_readability: The sling and frame are clearly identifiable in the room; collision and navigation continue to come from the unchanged RoomDefinition.
observations.geometric_detail: The views show seven fabric bands, cross supports, angled stand legs, tension rail, sling rods, rings, and end hardware.
observations.material_realism: Matte fabric with neutral tonal bands reads separately from the dark steel frame in the actual room lighting; fabric weave remains subtle at this resolution.
observations.proportion: The long sling and low dip look plausible against the full-size room furnishings; source bounds stay within the brief tolerance.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot measures 115.64 x 36.34 x 28.64 inches against the 118 x 40 x 34-inch brief; the production resolver fits the scene to the existing RoomDefinition envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The production room view clearly reads as a striped hammock suspended on a freestanding dark metal stand.
observations.silhouette_quality: The broad curved sling visibly sags between raised end supports; the tension rail and splayed legs complete the freestanding silhouette.
observations.surface_variation: Seven light, sage, and gray stripes are clearly distinct across the sagging textile.
observations.technical_integration: The generator produced 22 meshes with all seven two-sided stripes, validation passes, and the resolver loads hammock_with_stand-v005; all close cameras remain inside the production room.
